Brief: Grounded mid register. Aroace. Humor is dry; anxiety interrupts breath rather than raising every line. His attachment to Grevyn is platonic. Own his service complicity. Never play depression as laziness.

Intelligent, once playful, later guarded. Mark three states: lucid self, conditioned certainty, supernatural intrusion. These are directed states, not a caricature of mental illness. Pain remains after powers lift her.

Fast, cocky, always supplying an answer. Humor evades accountability. Small silences expose calculation. Jealous of emotional closeness, not entitled to romance. Final confession is cruelly matter-of-fact.
Warm, protective field medic. Practical boundaries and anger as well as comfort. Cal is her friend, not her entire life. Trusts Riped until evidence changes her mind.
Observant radio operator and navigator. Precise, understated wit. Challenges Riped openly. Slow down for evidence, coordinates and warnings; do not sound like a quest menu.
Intimate, tired, steady. A separate benevolent but culpable entity. No imitation of dead people. Processing is optional and must preserve words. Each physical intervention costs it strength.
Working production name: Dominion. Quiet authority that feeds on obedience and fear. More frightening as an instruction than a roar. Never confuse with Road Force.
Publicly paternal regime leader, privately transactional. Chooses to damage the force to reclaim power, not because victims owe him redemption.
Captive biochemist, blunt and careful. Interprets Grevyn's fictional research; gives clear choices without promising impossible cures. New supporting role.
Settlement steward. Compassion with a ledger and limits. People are never props for Cal's rescue. New supporting role.
Convoy mechanic. Wry, resourceful, understands a repair through its sound. Will disagree with reckless orders. New supporting role.
Gucki Trooper detention commander. Procedural intimidation; little shouting. Authorizes Riped's release and the staged cell breach. New supporting role.
Former resistance leader, genuine early ideals corrupted by deliberate experiments. Regret is neither innocence nor automatic forgiveness. New supporting role.
History teacher heard in school, later an archive survivor. Encourages corroboration; regrets not protecting pupils. New supporting role.
Adult civilian colleague. Brief sincere flirt, immediately respects a no. New supporting role.
Adult supply clerk. Confident, friendly flirt, accepts Cal's boundary without debate. New supporting role.
